blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Solve for x: three x plus six equals twenty-one.
Work backwards. The last thing done to 3x was adding six, so subtract six from both sides. Three x equals fifteen.
Now x is multiplied by three. Divide both sides by three, and x equals five.
So the answer is x equals five. Check it. Put five in for x, and both sides equal twenty-one.
Watch out for these traps. If you stop after subtracting six, you get fifteen. If you add six instead of subtracting it, you get nine.
